Wykaz badań dotyczących budowy - modernizacji Krajowej Sieci Drogowej i odcinków w Regionie Tesalii. Coverage: Δ.Τ.Ε. / Π. Θ.. The portal shows the English title as "ДОСЛІДЖЕННЯ КОМУНІКАЦІЙНИХ ПРОЕКТІВ" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Δ.Τ.Ε. / Π. Θ.. Its keywords include Από μετάπτωση, Δημόσια Διοίκηση, repository.data.gov.gr. The listing shows 1 download or service links in XLS. The listing shows 2026-02-22 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-gr.
